Existing NextUI game/save protection and RFU fixes
replace: Connected state before remote GATT discovery and notification subscription
Tests that report missing BlueZ as PASS

source_review.brick_mic_reference: Use negotiated MTU, session identity, subscription lifecycle patterns; do not share Mic UUIDs or change its service

interaction.entry: Connection: Bluetooth; Create room / Join nearby room
host: Prepare local identity and save guards
Publish only an active game room
Show waiting state and cancel action
Show connected only after bilateral readiness
join: Scan only the GBA Link service, never generic paired devices
Show nearby room name and short identity suffix for duplicate names
Select room without entering MAC or pairing codes
Connect asynchronously with visible progress and cancel
Check full ROM SHA256, core SHA256, serial mode and wire version
Enter connected state after both data directions are ready
error: Distinguish no rooms, radio unavailable, timeout, incompatible ROM/core and peer disconnect
Retry before core session start without restarting game
After a used game link session require normal game reopen when current core safety guard demands it
Do not auto-switch transport or claim reconnection preserved game state
constraints: Never block emulation or UI on discovery/connect calls
Keep transport-specific address and relay fields out of Bluetooth flow
Cancel closes owned sockets/GATT subscriptions and owned advertisement only
Discard stale discovery/connect completion after cancellation
Do not disconnect other Bluetooth users, reset bluetoothd or modify Mic permissions
interaction.health_indicator: Separate host wait/peer pause/link loss from measured delay; do not label every delayed exchange as packet loss
simplicity: No MAC or IP entry in Bluetooth mode
Host creates room; peer joins nearby room
Use a single compatible room directly after player chooses Join; show a short list when multiple rooms exist
Compatibility checks are automatic; never silently choose an incompatible room

transport_selection.classic_l2cap: Candidate only. ERTM ordered stream can reuse existing bounded framing, identity and receive callbacks; discovery still required.
transport_selection.ble_gatt: Two-way BlueZ and raw ATT framing validated at negotiated MTU 517. Raw ATT avoids client multi-notification batching, requests owned 7.5ms connection timing, and waits for actual controller completion. Game integration still pending latency/long-run evidence.
transport_selection.conclusion: BLE can maintain complete CRC-checked two-way data for 600 seconds, but the current 29ms median, 120ms p99 and 299ms maximum do not establish smooth GBA play. Retain Wi-Fi and complete matched radio/pacing/burst controls before choosing a production path.
acceptance: No payload corruption or truncation across repeated sessions
Measure p50/p95/p99/max, stalls above 33/66/200ms and queue growth over 10-minute runs
Compare against Wi-Fi on the same pair with the same payload and pacing
Test both host assignments and simultaneous Wi-Fi/Bluetooth coexistence
Hardware UI validation: discovery, duplicate names, cancellation, timeout, mismatch and retry
User validates Mario Tennis menus, selection and gameplay; no automated game controls
Deploy only after production build, compatibility regression and explicit experimental mode identification
remaining_experiments: 10-minute bounded window4 transfer with complete final draining
Production duplex worker and asynchronous frontend IPC integration
Matched Wi-Fi/BLE comparison under fixed game load
Actual game menus, selection and match validation by the user
